loveMessage: Today is just the beginning of our forever trail. Every step with you feels like walking through a starlit garden where fireflies light up our dreams.
bengaliQuote: আমাদের গল্পটা শুরু হলো, যা চলবে চিরকাল... 💛
reasons: The way your eyes light up whenever we go on a random ghuraghuri trip.
How you love cats and notice every kitten along our walking path.
Your patient smile even when I get us lost on purpose just to spend more time with you.
The peaceful feeling in my heart when our Kabin was signed on June 19.
How you make every ordinary day feel like a magical fairy tale.

lockedChamber.title: Just For My Oaeshi 🔒
lockedChamber.content: My dearest bby, this sacred corner is just for you. From the moment our Kabin was sealed on June 19 to our Holud and beyond, you are my home and my ultimate adventure. I promise to hold your hand, explore every trail, and love you forever.
